items.description: A building in Jwala Nagar, east Delhi collapsed on Tuesday morning, resulting in fatalities and injuries. Every Thursday, the site buzzes with seekers, making it a lively cultural hotspot despite ongoing preservation debates.

FPI ownership in BSE 500 companies stood at a 12-year low of 17.3% in September.

items.author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
items.description: Delhi minister Parvesh Verma announced the opening of Sheesh Mahal for public visits starting next week. Arrangements for ticket bookings and reservations will be shared soon, and a media tour is planned. Verma criticized Kejriwal for purportedly demolishing structures to build his residence while claiming he would not live in luxury. Allegations about the expensive interiors, including smart lighting and costly materials, have been reiterated by Verma.

items.title: SC rejects UP govt's plea against stay on Azam Khan's conviction
items.author: AYUSH PANDEY
items.description: The Supreme Court has upheld the stay on Azam Khan's conviction, dismissing the Uttar Pradesh government's appeal. This verdict offers a significant reprieve to Khan's wife, Tazeen Fatma, and his son, Abdullah Azam Khan, who had filed similar appeals. Previously, the Allahabad High Court stayed Khan's conviction in a forged birth certificate case, highlighting the intricate legal battle surrounding Khan and his family.

items.title: Once fired by OpenAI, Sam Altman has a message for Jensen Huang after his Nvidia exit
items.author: TOI TECH DESK
items.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has declined to say whether Jensen Huang should return as Nvidia CEO, saying he doesn’t know enough to answer. Calling Huang a hero with flaws, Altman recalled his own 2023 ouster from OpenAI and said the AI industry will be fine without him. Huang resigned on November 12 over reported affairs, as allies push for his comeback and Nvidia’s board pursues a national security probe.

items.title: Net dollar purchases more than halve in October as hedging curbs support rupee
